title: Pricing Card Interface reference solution notes
review_notes: Completed illustrative HTML/CSS reference implementation for the project brief. It is kept repository-only; review actual browser rendering, accessibility, and compatibility before publishing. UI behavior beyond CSS is intentionally not implemented.
explanation: The three plan cards share spacing and type rules. The recommended plan receives a distinct border and badge rather than a new one-off component. Check the one-column mode on narrow screens; this is a visual prototype, not a payment flow.

manual_validation_checklist: Open index.html in a browser and verify that styles.css loads with no console or network errors.
Test a narrow viewport, a medium viewport, and a wide viewport; verify that no essential content is clipped.
Navigate every link and control with a keyboard and confirm the focus indicator remains visible.
Check contrast, text enlargement, long content, and the relevant reduced-motion or print behavior.
Confirm that demonstration-only controls are not presented as real application, account, game, inventory, or payment behavior.
